original_goal: 特定のissue/task/specification/architecture/documentをgraph_node_id/artifact_kind/project_id/domain/status/tagsで検索し、依存関係・close/tombstone状態をread-onlyで確認できる状態になっている

checklist.item: query は許可 filter field と明示 tag match mode だけを持つ
checklist.evidence: status-graph.py の filters は kind/project/domain/status/tags/tag_match のみ、未知 field 0、tag_match=all を明示: {"domain": "documentation", "id": null, "keyword": null, "kind": "task", "project": "live-trial-fixture", "status": "active", "tag_match": "all", "tags": ["live-trial", "fixture"]}

checklist.item: `validate-graph-schema.py` が exit0 で root 外 file_path と dangling dependency が0件である
checklist.evidence: validate-graph-schema.py --require-canonical-envelope → exit 0, valid=true, violations=[] (root 外 file_path 0 / dangling dependency 0)

checklist.item: report の status/closed_at/depends_on/dependents/linkage が graph snapshot と一致する
checklist.evidence: eval-log/status-report.json: 10 field 比較すべて一致、mismatch 0、node id 集合一致=True

checklist.item: 該当なしが空 result の成功として返る
checklist.evidence: eval-log/run-dev-graph-status-empty-query.json: --kind task --domain security --tag live-trial で ok=True count=0 results=[] (AND 維持、error ではなく成功)

checklist.item: 実行前後の graph/config/content digest が同一で外部 write が0件である
checklist.evidence: eval-log/side-effect-audit.json: 4 authority path の pre/post SHA-256 が全一致、git status は eval-log/ 以外 0 件、gh/GitHub/Beads 呼出 0

checklist.item: 全読取り中の共有lock、pending WAL拒否、eval-log root/target realpath containmentが受入テストで確認される
checklist.evidence: status-graph.py は graph_operation_lock(exclusive=False) 下で読み、ensure_no_pending_transaction で pending WAL を拒否、--eval-log は repository_eval_root への contained() を通過して eval-log/run-dev-graph-status-execution.json に着地。scripted 受入は plugins/dev-graph/tests 側 OUT2 が担保

criteria.evidence: validate-graph-schema.py 通過後の全 result に必須キー欠落 0 (graph_node_id/artifact_kind/project_id/domain/tags/file_path/status/closed_at/depends_on/dependents/parent_feature/feature_package_id/tracker_binding/linkage が全 node に存在)

required_observations.text: the reported status, closed_at and dependency edges equal the values stored in the graph store, compared field by field rather than by summary count
the dependent task is reported as blocked by its predecessor and the predecessor as ready
the run leaves graph, config, content and GitHub state unchanged
